look.why: one control: a round joystick on the side of the band, where the owner marked it; a long press on its centre records. The screen fills the glass face and is the recording sign; one dark glossy finish. On the evening of 13 November the owner chose the thin ring (3.20 mm block) with a custom screen panel that fills the face, in place of the taller 4.17 mm block of that morning. The exterior shown here (merged32h, ring sizes US 7 to 13) is the thin block with its earlier curved glass. The thin exterior with a flat cover glass and three small windows on each long side (two blind, one a slit the ribbon passes through) is being built for the 7 sizes. The 4.17 mm exterior is kept as a fallback (design/look/s1/merged417flat-notes.md)

inside.why: the inside model shown here is v9 (thin block, resin radio corner); its fit check passes at the seven ring sizes. It still holds the stock screen and the earlier glass. Its rebuild for the custom full-face panel, the flat glass, the side slits for the two ribbons and the sealed opening where one slit meets the motor's pocket waits on the new exterior (the main board for it is routed). The model for the 4.17 mm block (v10) is kept as a fallback in design/mech/thin/fallback-417

electronics.why: the circuit is complete in its files (netlist, schematic, parts) and its check passes; a circuit simulation of 13 tests passes (power paths, motor start, charge path, level shifter, case charger and status light). Every conductor of the ring and its case is in one list: 66 conductors, each with both ends, its carrier and its cut length per ring size, checked against the boards and the netlists. An independent review of 13 November found the list true and failed the build guide on 3 points (design/wiring/wiring-review-4.md). Two are fixed in the guide (the ground joints of the ribbons, the test of the case's thermistor joints); the third, the body files, waits on the thin ring's new exterior and inside model. The build guide and its joint table still describe a second soldering pass for the board's screen face, which the thin ring's board no longer needs: their rework is open. A requirement page for the custom screen panel is written for panel makers (design/mfg/specs/screen-panel-custom.md); no maker has answered

board.why: all 17 boards are routed: the ring's main board (4 layers), 14 band circuits (2 per ring size) and the 2 case boards; the design rules check gives 0 violations and 0 unconnected on each. Since the evening of 13 November the ring's main board is the thin ring's board: the screen connector sits on the under face at the hand end and no soldered part is left on the screen face, so a screen panel of up to 0.80 mm lies 0.10 mm over the board. Its 8 limits for the antenna, crystal and USB lines are met. One supply capacitor sits 3.9 mm from its chip pin because no nearer place is free; its effect is measured on the first board. Fabrication files, solder paste layers and drawings are regenerated for it; the board for the 4.17 mm fallback is kept in design/ecad/ring/pcb/fallback-417. Nothing is built or measured; four values need a measurement on the first ring (antenna match, 32 MHz clock accuracy, case input current, USB through the spring pins)

parts.why: the parts list holds 88 lines and 131 part references and its check passes with 0 failures; custom parts, bare pads and a few parts still need an order code from a supplier. A joint table lists the 99 solder and contact joints with what brings the solder, the tool, the heat and the check of each

behaviour.why: the behaviour rules follow the one-control ring: a long press on the joystick centre records, the screen is the recording sign and is never dark while a recording runs, the ring sleeps for shipping; their check passes. Software: steps 1 to 5 are done (core, paired devices and control, iPhone services, screens, Android relay). Step 6 (microphones, storage, USB transfer, power, factory tests, against simulated drivers) is written; a second independent review passed it; its minor findings are fixed and the full run of the fixed software is still to be read. The real ring's board files and the panel driver are not written. Nobody has run the software on hardware

case.why: the charging case is the soft cube the owner chose (45.4 x 45.9 x 41.4 mm, 700 mAh battery): the ring lies flat around a centre post, the lid swivels aside, and the ring charges through pads on the inside of its band. Its two boards are routed and its fit check passes at the seven ring sizes with the earlier ring models; the fit to the thin ring with its flat glass is not redone yet. The spring pin is a proposal, not confirmed by its maker

open.why: open on 13 November: the thin ring's new exterior, then the inside model, the body maker files, the build guide and the case fit on them; the panel maker's answers (thickness, lit area, cable); four measurements on the first ring; supplier questions and bench tests of the architecture (sections 12, 13, 16.9, 17.6, 17.9, open items S12 to S30)
